REASONING: My audit focuses on the structural integrity of the mitigation plan. The proposal does not attempt to deny the existing 2.3x disparity; instead, it builds a structural architecture of accountability around it. The four conditions create a closed loop of oversight: real-time detection (Condition 1), immediate human intervention (Condition 2), public transparency (Condition 3), and a temporal limit on deployment (Condition 4). Crucially, the 90-day sunset clause with community veto power prevents the "algorithmic lock-in" pattern by ensuring the system cannot become a permanent fixture without renewed, external consent. While the disparity is a high-risk factual reality, the proposed safeguards are structurally capable of interrupting the automation of that disparity. The structural logic holds.
